question: We are touring with our son who is interested in nursing. Is Joan Richards in charge of the nursing program, and how would we contact her?
answer:
Joan L. Richards is listed as “Director – Nursing Simulation Lab,” not as director of the overall nursing program [5]. Kathleen M. Burke’s directory title is “Assistant Dean of Nursing Programs / Professor of Nursing” [6]; a page identifies her as Program Director specifically for the DNP program [8]. The pages don’t verify who is in charge of all nursing programs. Joan’s email is jrichar2@ramapo.edu, phone is (201) 684-7427, and office is AC-201F [5]. For the overall program, contact the Nursing Programs Office at (201) 684-7749; it is in Adler Center for Nursing Excellence 215.

Sources: [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/snh/faculty/joan-l-richards/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/snh/faculty/kathleen-m-burke/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/doctorate-in-nursing-practice-program/)
